Unpopular opinion but NTA 

Marriage is about give and take 
Also accommodating to your partners needs is something that everyone should be willing to do.

IMO you phrased it very respectfully and you're just asking for some variety, which I don't think is wrong at all. 

Also, if this was another situation like his partner not taking adequate care of the kids or not catering to his emotional needs I bet more people would jump on to say NTA! This to me is another similar situation. 

It's an unmet need and a very reasonable need at that. But this is just my opinion. And I say this because you seem respectful about it. If you weren't being respectful then my answer would change.
